items.item_text: Certified Medical Assistant (CMA) OR Certificate of completion of a Medical Assistant training program.
BART or BLS at time of hire with commitment to get BART within six (6) months of hire date.
Must be able to work various hours and locations based on business needs.
Employment is subject to a criminal background check and pre-employment physical.
Minimum Two (2) years of experience as a MA in an ambulatory medical practice.
Five (5) years of recent experienced (within the last 2 years)as an MA.
Experience in mental health and/or addiction treatment setting.
Experience working with Neurology (headache and migraine) patient populations.
Experience in a fast-paced, multi-specialty clinic
Knowledge and experience processing medication prior authorizations and durable medical equipment (DME) prior authorizations
Scheduling experience.
Experience assisting with procedures.
Experience with EPIC and Cadence module.
Experience with Epic in-basket management (MA/nurse pools and Refill pools)
Experience working with senior population.
Experience working with vulnerable patient populations

Under direct supervision of the clinic supervisor and the general supervision of the clinic providers, performs work which requires specific knowledge and training in patient care duties within the Business and Professions Code of the State of California and the regulations of the Joint Commission of the Accreditation of Hospitals (TJC). These duties also include but are not limited to: all aspects of front office management, appointment scheduling, patient check-in, authorizations, accurate billing, payment processing, supply chain and forms management.Back office duties require equipment management, environmental care functions, cleaning/disinfecting the environment.

Requires knowledge of medical terminology, procedures, universal precautions and proper use of body mechanics. Position requires initiative, ability to prioritize demands and ability to work in a team environment. Position may also require various testing which may include audiograms, ECG's, forensic urine drug screen collection, venipuncture/specimen processing, TB skin testing and equipment calibration, administration of vaccines and assist with patient treatment.Use electronic medical record software for patient charting, patient screening for medical issues, translation services (Bilingual English/Spanish), chart preparation. Occasionally float to other departments to assist.
Strong computer literacy.
Requires knowledge of medical terminology, on-line scheduling, universal precautions, and proper use of body mechanics.
Must be able to function in a fast-paced environment, have excellent interpersonal and communication skills, and consistently demonstrate empathy and kindness to all staff and patients.
Possess the personal characteristics of professionalism, credibility, commitment to high standards, innovation, discriminating judgment and accountability.
Strong ability to take initiative, prioritize demands and work in a team environment.
Knowledge of workplace safety practices, regulatory compliance, incident reporting, and safety program implementation.
Strong understanding of clinic workflows, patient care coordination, and administrative processes.
Ability to work as a team member.
Ability to be flexible with varying demands in a small specialty clinic.
